title: ClaraTokenContract
description: Formal JSON Schema specifying JWT claims, constraints, and contracts for CLARA Care authentication tokens.

RoleEnum.description: Authorized RBAC role assigned to the token subject

sub.description: Subject identifier, strictly the normalized user email address

exp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds denoting token expiration

iat.description: Unix timestamp in seconds denoting token issuance time

iss.description: Issuer identifier authority (e.g., clara-api or theclaracare.com)

jti.description: Unique cryptographic JWT identifier used for rotation and denylist tracking
